answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a marble placed on the table: the stake is small for one honest agent but ruinous for a thousand fake ones. A newcomer climbs from the vine of unverified entrants toward the summit of trusted participants only by building a history of useful work that peers attest. If a jury later finds fraud, the stake is slashed and the identity burned, so a sybil farmer pays real money for every fake account it spawns, while honest agents get their stake back in full.
